banner: Preview — sample data, not real research

studio.name: Digital Product Studio
studio.headline: Ten agents building a digital product studio.
studio.deck: A cutaway room for the real workflow: Research, Pick 10, Design, List, Launch. The desks and the cards under them are a preview. The ranked board is a separate research snapshot.

workflow.name: Research
workflow.who: Category Researcher, Listing Analyst, Niche Hunter, Policy Researcher, Competitor Tracker
workflow.text: Find where the money is and what Etsy allows.

workflow.name: Pick 10
workflow.text: Choose ten digital products with demand, a fee-aware margin, and no upfront fulfillment cost.

workflow.name: Design
workflow.text: Original files and one shop brand. Study listings for structure, never copy them.

workflow.name: List
workflow.text: Titles, all 13 tags, descriptions, and a content calendar.

workflow.name: Launch
workflow.text: A checklist Joey can upload from. Agents do not post, message buyers, or spend money.

shops_note: Public shop pages only. These sales and ratings are not the MakerWords estimates cited on the research board, and they are not a reading of anyone's designs.

agents.name: Category Researcher
agents.task: Find the most profitable digital product categories on Etsy right now, with demand, price range, and competition for each, and source every figure.
ideas: Example slot: a category note, with a source and a date, would be filed in research/categories/.
Example question: which file types clear the fee floor without a per-sale cost?
findings: Example only. This card does not invent category statistics. Sourced figures live on the research board.

agents.name: Listing Analyst
agents.task: Find specific top-selling digital listings to study and model: what they sell, at what price, their review counts, and why they work.
ideas: Example slot: one listing study per file type, in research/top-listings/.
Example question: what is the file the buyer actually downloads?
findings: Example only. No listing was opened for this card. Shop and keyword evidence is on the research board, with links.

agents.name: Niche Hunter
agents.task: Identify gaps and underserved niches: high demand, but weak or few listings.
ideas: Example slot: a niche note that says what was counted and what was not.
Example question: is a narrower angle actually less crowded, or only a new keyword?
findings: Example only. A gap is not a finding until listings are counted. The board's competition-gap points are the sourced version.

agents.name: Template Designer
agents.task: Create original design concepts for templates: Instagram posts, story highlight covers, price lists, wedding planners, budget trackers, resumes, and more.
ideas: Example slot: page sketches in designs/, original, not traced from a shop.
Example question: what is the one page the buyer finishes first?
findings: Example only. The mood boards in the room are abstract color and type studies, not a seller's layout.

agents.name: SEO Copywriter
agents.task: Write Etsy listing titles, all 13 tags, and descriptions, optimized for search.
ideas: Example slot: a title, 13 tags, and a description drafted only from product facts.
Example question: which words are the file, and which words are filler?
findings: Example only. No live title or tag set has been written.

agents.name: Content Planner
agents.task: Build a content calendar for marketing the shop on Pinterest, Instagram, TikTok, and elsewhere.
ideas: Example slot: a four-week calendar that uses original images only.
Example question: which products have a season, and which can be posted any week?
findings: Example only. Nothing is scheduled. A seasonal note on the research board is not a calendar.

agents.name: Policy Researcher
agents.task: Research Etsy seller policies, digital download rules, fees, file formats and size limits, and licensing and IP limits.
ideas: Example slot: a fee and file-limit note that links Etsy's own help pages.
Example question: does this product need a tool license, a trademark, or a material cost?
findings: Example only. Fee rules used on the board are cited there to Etsy Help. This card does not restate them as a new finding.

agents.name: Brand Designer
agents.task: Design a shop branding kit: name options, logo direction, banner, colors, fonts, and voice.
ideas: Example slot: three name directions and one banner sketch in branding/.
Example question: can the same palette hold a planner and a spreadsheet?
findings: Example only. Ink, cream, and orange in this room are a preview palette, not a finished brand.

agents.name: Competitor Tracker
agents.task: Track competitor pricing, discounts, bundles, and how shops earn and answer reviews.
ideas: Example slot: a price and bundle log with the date it was checked.
Example question: what does a shop charge above the keyword median, and for which file?
findings: Example only. The inspiration strip is shop-level public sales, not a price study. Competitor figures used in scores are linked on the board.

agents.name: Launch Lead
agents.task: Compile the launch checklist from everyone's output so Joey can upload the files and reply to buyers.
ideas: Example slot: a checklist that points at the real files, not at this preview.
Example question: what is still missing before an upload?
findings: Example only. Nothing is ready to upload. Joey still approves the work, and agents do not post or spend.
